notes: Flowable stall-remedy knowledge base. Each flow is an ordered list of steps the troubleshooter walks across restarts. Curated from community troubleshooting (DeepWiki winebox64/winlator, XDA, Winlator101). Extend by adding flows/steps; ship updates by placing an updated copy at filesDir/diagnostics/stall_solutions.json.

steps.title: Use WineD3D (OpenGL)
steps.rationale: The game could not create a Vulkan rendering surface. WineD3D renders Direct3D through OpenGL and avoids the failing Vulkan-surface path.

steps.title: Switch to the Turnip driver
steps.rationale: For a natively-Vulkan game, a different Vulkan driver often succeeds where the current one fails to allocate the surface window.

steps.title: Switch to the Vortek driver
steps.rationale: A conservative Vulkan driver fallback for surface-allocation failures.

steps.title: Switch to the PulseAudio driver
steps.rationale: The game went silent right after ALSA audio initialized, which often means it is blocked opening the ALSA device. PulseAudio uses a non-blocking backend.

steps.title: Switch to the ALSA driver
steps.rationale: If PulseAudio stalls, fall back to ALSA.

steps.title: Disable audio
steps.rationale: The game hangs while initializing audio. Disabling audio makes Wine load no audio backend at all, which avoids the stall (at the cost of in-game sound).

steps.title: Use the Box64 Stability preset
steps.rationale: Unity games are prone to dynarec crashes; the Stability preset trades speed for reliable startup.

steps.title: Enable 32-bit memory mapping
steps.rationale: BOX64_MMAP32=1 fixes black screens on some Unity titles, especially on Adreno GPUs.

steps.title: Use WineD3D (OpenGL)
steps.rationale: Some Unity builds present a black screen under DXVK; WineD3D renders through OpenGL instead.

steps.title: Enable legacy graphics compatibility
steps.rationale: Older games expect pre-2003 OpenGL extensions; MESA_EXTENSION_MAX_YEAR restores that behavior.

steps.title: Use WineD3D (OpenGL)
steps.rationale: Legacy Direct3D titles are more compatible with WineD3D than with Vulkan translation.

steps.title: Switch to the Turnip driver
steps.rationale: Turnip is the recommended Vulkan driver for Adreno GPUs and fixes many black screens.

steps.title: Switch to the Vortek driver
steps.rationale: Vortek is a conservative fallback when Turnip stalls on your device.

steps.title: Switch to DXVK (Vulkan)
steps.rationale: The window opened but never presented; DXVK routes Direct3D through Vulkan and often resolves this.

steps.title: Use WineD3D (OpenGL)
steps.rationale: If Vulkan translation stalls after the first frame, WineD3D renders through OpenGL instead.

steps.title: Lower the game resolution
steps.rationale: Reduces render-target and memory pressure that can stall the first presented frame.

steps.title: Use the Box64 Stability preset
steps.rationale: Disables aggressive CPU-translation optimizations that can hang before the first window appears.

steps.title: Use compatibility graphics
steps.rationale: Switches to a conservative Vortek + WineD3D configuration for early-startup stalls.

steps.title: Switch to the Vortek driver
steps.rationale: Graphics initialization stalled; Vortek is a conservative driver that avoids the failing path.

steps.title: Use WineD3D (OpenGL)
steps.rationale: Avoids the Vulkan translation layer that appears to be stalling during initialization.
